$comment: Excel-authored workbooks for the fidelity tests. scripts/fidelity/fetch-corpus.mjs downloads each file from its source at the pinned commit into corpus/<id>.xlsx. IronCalc workbooks keep the results Excel computed (values axis); rust_xlsxwriter files are one Excel feature each, made in Excel (round-trip axis). Tags group the report (see e2e/fidelity/README.md).

cases.unstable: ACCRINT results depend on which workbooks the page opened before (calc_method read as FALSE); not understood yet

cases.skip: Too large to load whole (a reference near the last row): TeamGrid streams it, so its formulas are not recalculated, and opening it can take longer than the test allows (CI)

cases.skipRoundtrip: A note in the last cell (XFD1048576): TeamGrid builds the whole grid, which takes about 30 s, and drops that note
